evidence.title: dossi · stop chasing borrowers, close faster

name: dossi
summary: AI agent for mortgage loan officers that requests, chases and validates borrower documents.
description: dossi reads a loan file, generates its document conditions, emails the borrower one secure link and runs the chase until every item is cleared. A live file view shows each document's state (open, request, chase, receive, clear) and an activity log of every agent action, so closing dates hold without manual follow-up.
contains: AI agent that reads a loan file and generates its document conditions
borrowers get one secure link instead of another login
chases missing documents and validates what arrives
per-document states: open, request, chase, receive, clear
activity log of every agent action
built for mortgage loan officers on files such as conventional purchases
